response.sql: WITH color_totals AS (SELECT p.product_color AS color, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) AS total FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), stats AS (SELECT color, total, total * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total) FROM color_totals) AS share, (SELECT AVG(total) FROM color_totals) AS avg_total FROM color_totals) SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_invoiced_amount, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(total - avg_total) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM stats WHERE total > avg_total
